svg.text: whole frames: each stage waits for the last
8 slices: each stage starts on the first slice
video link · glass-to-glass latency · 4K camera to 1080p screen
every stage takes time; what you see is where the drone was
encode and send in slices, so the stages overlap instead of queueing
